method: Fresh codex app-server process, initialize then skills/list(cwds=[Dental], forceReload=true)

skills.name: odoo-guidelines
skills.description: House rules for Odoo addon code: module structure, manifest, Python/ORM, fields, controllers, XML views and data, QWeb reports, access rights and record rules, performance, tests. Use when writing or reviewing any file in an Odoo addon outside static/ (for the JavaScript, Owl templates and SCSS under static/, see odoo-web-guidelines).

skills.name: odoo-review
skills.description: Review Odoo addon code against the house rules, dispatching each changed file to the matching odoo-guidelines, odoo-web-guidelines, and odoo-security material. Use when reviewing a diff, commit, PR, or module.

skills.name: odoo-security
skills.description: Security audit of Odoo addon code: access control (ir.access, field groups, sudo), injection (SQL, domain, eval, XSS via Markup/markup()), untrusted public methods/RPC, controller auth/CSRF, file access, deserialization, returning complex objects, getattr/setattr, timing attacks. Use when auditing an addon, or judging whether a specific construct (a sudo, raw SQL, a route, ...) is safe.

skills.name: odoo-web-guidelines
skills.description: House rules for the web framework code of Odoo addons: the JavaScript, Owl templates and SCSS in static/src/ and static/tests/ of any addon (community, enterprise, or custom). Use when writing, reviewing, or moving files under static/ in an Odoo addon.

skills.name: sd-odoo-dental
skills.description: Apply SD Dental reuse-first architecture policy when assessing, designing, implementing, or reviewing features in the maintained Odoo 20 dental_clinic and SD addons. Require a source-backed reuse audit before feature implementation.
